title: Formula sheet for Earned Value Management (EVM)
body: Here is a quick cheat sheet for PMBOK formula calculations: CV = EV - AC, SV = EV - PV, CPI = EV / AC, SPI = EV / PV. Good luck!
author: mock_q1hgocb81msk0d5fj

comments.author: mock_ud3nft23vmsk0d5fj
comments.body: Excellent summary Rahul! Make sure to also remember that an index greater than 1.0 is favorable.
